Subject: SmallPay onboarding — pilot billing path (PO vs invoice)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — team liked the latency profile. We want to spin up a 60-day pilot (metered, low-volume) before committing to Dedicated. Our procurement is lean: they prefer invoice-based billing for pilots to avoid setting up long PO cycles for small monthly spend. Can Redwood support a temporary invoice-only path for the trial (no PO) with the understanding we'll move to PO for post-pilot commitments?

Attached: smallpay_vendor_intake.pdf and proof-of-insurance.pdf.

If you need a payment card on file or a signed SOW instead, we can do that quickly. Looking for the minimal operational friction to start.

Best,

Team — reviewed the intake and insurance doc. Procurement is open to a conditional exception for SmallPay under the following binding controls: 

1) Pilot ceiling: invoice-only allowed for up to $7,500 USD/month for a maximum of 90 days. Any forecast above that requires a PO before activation.
2) Evidence: vendor intake + proof of insurance (received) + W-9 or local tax form on file prior to first invoice.
3) Audit & trace: all invoices to be routed to finance@redwood.ai and stored in our procurement folder; we will sample invoices at 30 and 60 days for compliance.
4) Roll-up: procurement will issue a conditional approval document (procurement-exception-SP-034) to be signed by the vendor and finance.

If Finance agrees to accept invoices and to process payments under these rules, Procurement will mark the vendor Allowlist:temp-invoice route and set a hard expiration.

I've attached a one-page conditional approval to use as the vendor-facing doc. If you want, Kimberly, I can send the DocuSign request after Finance signoff.

— Priyom
Senior Manager, Procurement | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: SmallPay onboarding — pilot billing path (PO vs invoice)

All — Finance OK to accept invoices for the 90-day pilot with the Procurement controls Priyom listed, subject to two finance conditions: 

A) Remit info: vendor must supply bank remit (ACH) and a billing contact. Invoices must include the Deal ID (SP-2027-034) in the invoice number.
B) Retainer for new merchants: Redwood will require a $1,000 refundable retainer or a credit card on file if the vendor has no prior payments history with us (SmallPay is new). The retainer offsets chargebacks and reduces payment friction. Retainer will be returned after 90 days if account in good standing.

Alex — if you accept these terms I will trigger the DocuSign for the conditional approval and instruct AP to expect invoices with the Deal ID. Please confirm the pilot spend estimate so we can finalize today.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference
